entities.summary: Spanish, a notable figure in the history of Venezuela, associated with European Contact, the Welser Colony, and Early Colonization (1498–1528). Preceded by Columbus reaches Venezuelan coast — August 1498, first mainland landing. Their legacy influenced Vespucci/Ojeda name the region 'Venezuela' (Little Venice) and Welser banking family granted Province of Venezuela.
